van_gogh_style.description: Expressive painterly style with strong motion and thick brush texture.
van_gogh_style.prompt_hint: expressive swirling brush strokes, thick impasto oil texture, vivid contrasting colors
van_gogh_style.negative_prompt_hint: smooth digital shading, photorealistic rendering, minimal texture

monet_style.description: Soft impressionist style with gentle light and atmospheric color.
monet_style.prompt_hint: soft impressionist brushwork, gentle natural lighting, pastel atmospheric tones
monet_style.negative_prompt_hint: sharp hard outlines, high contrast comic shading, photorealistic detail

watercolor_style.description: Transparent watercolor painting with soft pigment flow.
watercolor_style.prompt_hint: soft watercolor pigment texture, transparent layered washes, subtle paper grain
watercolor_style.negative_prompt_hint: thick oil paint texture, hard digital edges, glossy plastic surface

oil_painting_style.description: Traditional oil painting style with rich texture and layered brushwork.
oil_painting_style.prompt_hint: rich oil paint texture, layered painterly brush strokes, dramatic artistic lighting
oil_painting_style.negative_prompt_hint: flat digital shading, watercolor transparency, smooth plastic surfaces

comic_style.description: Bold graphic comic rendering with outlines and flat colors.
comic_style.prompt_hint: bold inked outlines, high-contrast cel shading, graphic comic rendering
comic_style.negative_prompt_hint: soft watercolor blending, hazy impressionist edges, realistic photographic texture

fairy_tale_illustration_style.description: Dreamy storybook illustration with magical softness.
fairy_tale_illustration_style.prompt_hint: dreamy storybook illustration texture, soft magical lighting, whimsical decorative details
fairy_tale_illustration_style.negative_prompt_hint: harsh realistic lighting, dark horror atmosphere, technical industrial rendering
